summary: Quetta Acquisition Corp, a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting receipt of Nasdaq approval to transfer its securities listing from the Nasdaq Global Market to the Nasdaq Capital Market, effective May 14, 2026. The transfer follows a delisting notice due to failure to meet the minimum Market Value of Listed Securities (MVLS) requirement. With the transfer, the company regained MVLS compliance and the Nasdaq hearing was cancelled. This is a routine listing transfer with no special situation; no deal terms exist. Risk-arb: Not applicable.
